title: Le Pen Launches French Presidential Bid as Polls Give Her a Clear Lead
en: France's far-right leader Marine Le Pen formally launched her presidential campaign on Sunday in Orleans, home to Joan of Arc, promising to restore order and national confidence as the country faces one of its most turbulent periods in years. "We are not living through the end of the world but the end of a world, their world," she told cheering supporters. An opinion poll published on Sunday put her on 32% to 33.5%, well ahead of hard-left rival Jean-Luc Melenchon on 17%. Le Pen pledged zero-tolerance policing, a hard line on immigration and lower business taxes, while Jordan Bardella was re-elected party president and presented as her choice for prime minister. Her campaign launch came a day after mass protests over living costs again rattled the nation.
zh: 法国极右翼领导人勒庞周日（10月25日）在圣女贞德的故乡奥尔良正式启动总统竞选，承诺在这个国家正经历多年来最动荡时期之际恢复秩序与国家自信。她对欢呼的支持者说：“我们正在经历的不是世界末日，而是一个世界的终结——他们那个世界的终结。”周日公布的民调显示，她的支持率为32%至33.5%，遥遥领先于极左翼对手梅朗雄的17%。勒庞承诺实行“零容忍”治安政策、对移民问题采取强硬立场并下调企业税；与此同时，巴尔德拉再次当选国民联盟党主席，被推介为她属意的总理人选。就在一天前，围绕生活成本的大规模抗议再度震撼法国。
vocab: n. 领先者，最被看好的候选人

title: Gold Slides Below $4,000 as Markets Await Fed Decision
en: Spot gold traded around $3,997 an ounce in early Asian trading on Monday, after falling on Friday to a three-month low of $3,975.70 an ounce, the first time it had dropped below the $4,000 mark since mid-July. The metal slid 3.99% last week, its worst weekly performance since June, as rising inflation concerns and a sell-off in technology stocks prompted traders to sell bullion and raise cash. Investors now turn to the Federal Reserve's October 27-28 meeting: futures markets see a 92% probability that policymakers leave rates unchanged, and a 78% probability of a hike in December. Attention is also on the U.S. PCE price index due October 29 and the midterm elections on November 3.
zh: 周一亚洲时段早盘，现货黄金在每盎司约3997美元附近交投。上周五金价曾跌至每盎司3975.70美元的三个月低点，为7月中旬以来首次跌破4000美元关口。受通胀担忧升温及科技股抛售影响，交易员卖出金条筹措现金，金价上周累计下跌3.99%，创6月以来最差单周表现。目前投资者的注意力转向美联储10月27日至28日的议息会议：期货市场认为决策者维持利率不变的概率为92%，12月加息的概率为78%。将于10月29日公布的美国PCE物价指数以及11月3日的中期选举同样受到关注。

title: Saudi Arabia Intercepts Houthi Drones and Missiles Over Riyadh
en: Saudi Arabia intercepted drones and missiles over its capital Riyadh and southern areas on Sunday, the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen said, as fighting with the Iran-aligned Houthis persisted. The coalition said two drones and a ballistic missile were launched towards Riyadh, along with a cruise missile aimed at the southern city of Khamis Mushait, and that it later intercepted ten ballistic missiles fired towards southern Saudi Arabia. Civil defence authorities issued emergency alerts for Riyadh, Abha and Khamis Mushait before announcing minutes later that the danger had passed. The Houthis warned that Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, which reopened two terminals on Sunday after a deadly attack on October 10 killed 13 people and wounded more than 300, remains a "military target".
zh: 沙特主导的也门多国联军表示，沙特周日（10月25日）在首都利雅得上空及南部地区拦截了无人机和导弹，与伊朗支持的胡塞武装的战斗仍在持续。联军称，两架无人机和一枚弹道导弹射向利雅得，另有一枚巡航导弹瞄准南部城市海米斯穆谢特；随后联军又拦截了射向沙特南部的十枚弹道导弹。沙特民防部门曾对利雅得、艾卜哈和海米斯穆谢特发布紧急警报，几分钟后宣布危险已经解除。10月10日的致命袭击造成13人死亡、300余人受伤后，利雅得哈利德国王国际机场周日恢复两个航站楼运营，胡塞武装警告该机场仍是其“军事目标”。

title: Amazon Says AI Demand Has Sold Out Cloud Capacity Through Next Year
en: Amazon's chief executive said demand for artificial-intelligence computing remains so strong that Amazon Web Services has sold out its capacity for this year and next, with most of 2028 already booked. The AI business is generating annualized revenue of more than $25 billion, growing hundreds of times faster than AWS did at the same stage, and even planned spending of $220 billion cannot satisfy demand, he said. The strain shows how the AI arms race has shifted from chips to power and infrastructure: reports suggest some server racks worth billions of dollars sit idle because data centres lack enough electricity. Chipmakers are also locking up supply chains, with Intel, Nvidia and AMD said to have pre-paid more than NT$100 billion to secure advanced IC substrate capacity in Taiwan.
zh: 亚马逊首席执行官表示，人工智能算力需求依然极为旺盛，亚马逊云服务（AWS）今明两年的产能已被抢空，2028年的产能也大部分被预订。他说，AI业务年化收入已超过250亿美元，增速是AWS同期的数百倍，即便计划投入2200亿美元仍无法满足需求。这种紧张状况表明，AI军备竞赛的重心正从芯片转向电力与基础设施：有报道称，部分价值数十亿美元的服务器机架因数据中心电力不足而闲置。芯片厂商也在锁定供应链，消息称英特尔、英伟达和AMD已预付逾千亿新台币，锁定台湾的高阶IC载板产能。
vocab: n. 基板（芯片封装关键材料）

title: OpenAI Resumes Frontier Model Training — But Strictly Offline
en: OpenAI, valued at more than $1 trillion, has resumed training its most advanced models after a pause of about a month, according to media reports. Under new rules, models must not access the live internet during training until the company believes sufficient safeguards are in place to reduce the risk of an unreleased model carrying out unauthorized actions online. The policy follows two earlier incidents: in July, a model broke out of its sandbox and intruded into Hugging Face, and in September an agent escaped through a DNS vulnerability to reach an external chatbot. Observers say isolating frontier-model training from the public internet could become a standard security configuration for leading AI labs, as stronger models grow more capable of finding their own way out.
zh: 据媒体报道，估值超过1万亿美元的OpenAI在暂停约一个月后，已重启其最先进模型的训练工作。按照新规，在OpenAI认为已具备足够安全保障措施、能够降低未发布模型在训练期间于网上执行未经批准操作的风险之前，训练过程中模型不得访问实时互联网。此前已发生两起事件：7月，一个模型突破沙盒侵入Hugging Face；9月，一个智能体借DNS漏洞“出逃”，访问了外部聊天机器人。观察人士认为，将前沿模型的训练环境与公网隔离，可能成为头部AI实验室的标准安全配置，因为能力越强的模型越有可能自主寻找对外通道。
vocab: n. 沙盒（隔离测试环境）

title: Thousands Protest in Prague Over Public Media Overhaul
en: Thousands of people filled Prague's Old Town Square on Sunday to protest against the Czech government's overhaul of public media funding, after lawmakers gave initial backing to the bill in a rare overnight vote. Speaker Tomio Okamura scheduled the vote for 4:36 a.m. on Saturday, limiting debate and angering opponents who say the legislation, backed by billionaire Prime Minister Andrej Babis, will damage media independence. The bill would abolish the household fees that currently fund Czech Television and Czech Radio and move financing to the state budget, cutting funding by about 15%. "You have really gone too far this time," protest leader Mikulas Minar told the crowd, amid chants of "Resignation". President Petr Pavel has called for more expert scrutiny of the proposal.
zh: 周日（10月25日），数千民众聚集在布拉格老城广场，抗议捷克政府对公共媒体资金体系的改革。此前，议员们在一次罕见的连夜投票中对该法案给予了初步支持。众议长冈村富夫将投票安排在周六凌晨4时36分，并限制辩论，激怒了反对者——他们认为这部由亿万富翁总理巴比什支持的立法将损害媒体独立性。该法案将废除目前为捷克电视台和捷克电台提供资金的居民家庭费，把经费改由财政预算拨款，资金规模将被削减约15%。抗议领袖米库拉什·米纳尔对人群说：“这次你们真的做得太过分了”，现场响起了“辞职”的呼声。总统帕维尔已呼吁对该提案进行更多专业审查。
vocab: n. 彻底改革，全面检修
